title: The Why the Blue Cup Is Papa's
youtube_title: The Why the Blue Cup Is Papa's | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting your turn to talk lets someone feel heard.
summary: At a cottage hearth with the clock unhurried, Auntie June begins to tell Yael about why the blue cup is Papa's even when it is clean and free. Yael wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
